Justin, saw Airiam acquired Vantage Point Solutions Group, extending the footprint across the DC metro and Mid-Atlantic.

A buy-and-build push usually means more SME accounts worth reaching than the team can cover before they go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

Justin, quick follow-up for Airiam.

After an acquisition the cross-sell target usually climbs faster than you can ramp reps. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Airiam needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Justin, last bit of proof for Airiam.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. With our AI SDR they reached $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM. I pulled a benchmark of how Airiam's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage security firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
